headline: Premier League recap: Spurs stun Chelsea, City lose unbeaten record to Villa
description: Tottenham Hotspur get a rare away win against Chelsea, as Arsenal and Man City are both joint-top of the Premier League, on a Saturday full of matches across Europe.

headline: Cole Palmer sent off as Tottenham win at Chelsea
description: Cole Palmer was sent off as Chelsea fell to a 2-0 defeat to Tottenham at Stamford Bridge on Saturday.

headline: Did Arsenal prioritise the result over performance vs. Everton?
description: Did Arsenal prioritise the result over performance vs. Everton?

headline: Arise Arsenal, the people's Premier League champions
description: The sight of Man City pulling clear at the top of the Premier League table was not a good look for the biggest league in the world. But Arsenal's win against Everton showed they are ready to fight all the way this season.

headline: Man City lose 100% Premier League record with defeat at Aston Villa
description: Manchester City suffered defeat for the first time in the Premier League this season when Nicolas Jackson's double earned Aston Villa a 2-1 victory at Villa Park.

headline: Marc Guéhi form doesn't worry Man City boss Enzo Maresca despite errors
description: Manchester City boss Enzo Maresca is not worried by the form of defender Marc Guéhi after his mistake contributed to their 2-1 defeat at Aston Villa.
